name: CRM Inbox Settings

fields.label: Office hours
fields.description: Days and hours your team answers. Outside them the customer gets the away message once.

fields.label: Away message
fields.default: Gracias por escribirnos. En este momento estamos fuera de horario; te responderemos en cuanto abramos.

fields.label: Send the away message again after (hours)
Ask customers to rate the conversation when it is closed
Rating message
fields.default: ¡Gracias por escribirnos! ¿Cómo te atendimos? Califícanos en un toque: {link}
fields.description: {link} is replaced by the rating page for this conversation.

fields.label: Assign new customer conversations automatically
fields.description: Each unassigned conversation goes to the available person with the fewest open conversations. People turn their availability on and off from the inbox.

fields.label: Reopen a closed conversation when the customer writes again
fields.description: It goes back to the person who had it, if they can still answer it; otherwise it waits in «Sin asignar».

fields.label: First reply within (minutes)
fields.description: The late reply alert uses it for every wait, counted from the customer's first unanswered message.

fields.label: Alert when a customer waits longer than the reply goal
fields.description: Tells the person who has the conversation, or the managers when nobody has it. Once per wait, and only while you are open when office hours are on.

description: How the customer inbox answers outside office hours, asks for ratings and assigns conversations.
